name: scoped-search
title: Scoped Search
description: Search only inside the folders you choose, with a configurable depth limit. No whole-disk scanning.
author: kervanaslan

commands.name: search
commands.title: Scoped Search
commands.subtitle: Scoped Search
commands.description: Search inside your configured folders only.

commands.name: manage
commands.title: Manage Search Folders
commands.subtitle: Scoped Search
commands.description: Add, remove, enable or disable the folders that are searched.

preferences.name: maxDepth
preferences.title: Search Depth
preferences.description: How many levels below each configured folder to include. 1 = only the direct children.

preferences.name: itemType
preferences.title: Include
preferences.description: What to list in the search results.

preferences.name: showHidden
preferences.label: Include hidden items
preferences.description: Include entries whose name starts with a dot.

preferences.name: excludeNames
preferences.title: Exclude Names
preferences.description: Comma-separated folder/file names to skip entirely (also stops descending into them).
preferences.default: node_modules, .git, .next, dist, build, .venv, venv, __pycache__, .DS_Store, Pods, target, .cache

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal App
preferences.description: Application used by the "Open in Terminal" action.

preferences.name: editorApp
preferences.title: Editor App
preferences.description: Application used by the "Open in Editor" action.

preferences.name: maxResults
preferences.title: Result Limit
preferences.description: Safety cap on how many entries are loaded into the list.
